```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(pins)
library(nanoparquet) # pins reads Parquet pins through nanoparquet

energy_board <- function() {
  name <- Sys.getenv("ENERGY_PIN", "energy_indicators")
  if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("CONNECT_SERVER")) && nzchar(Sys.getenv("CONNECT_API_KEY"))) {
    list(board = board_connect(auth = "envvar"), name = name)
  } else {
    list(
      board = board_folder(Sys.getenv("ENERGY_PINS_DIR", "../_pins")),
      name = basename(name)
    )
  }
}

pin <- energy_board()
energy <- pin_read(pin$board, pin$name)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
millions <- function(x) formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")

ssa_access <- energy |> filter(iso3 == "SSF", indicator == "elec_access")
latest_year <- max(ssa_access$year)
latest_access <- ssa_access$value[ssa_access$year == latest_year]

ssa_without <- energy |> filter(iso3 == "SSF", indicator == "pop_no_elec")
without_now <- ssa_without$value[ssa_without$year == latest_year]
without_2015 <- ssa_without$value[ssa_without$year == 2015]
change <- without_now - without_2015
change_text <- if (change < 0) {
  paste("down", millions(-change), "million since 2015")
} else {
  paste("up", millions(change), "million since 2015")
}

top10 <- energy |>
  filter(area_type == "country", region == "Sub-Saharan Africa", year == latest_year) |>
  filter(indicator %in% c("pop_no_elec", "elec_access")) |>
  select(name, indicator, value) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = indicator, values_from = value) |>
  slice_max(pop_no_elec, n = 10) |>
  transmute(
    Country = name,
    `People without electricity (millions)` = round(pop_no_elec / 1e6, 1),
    `Access to electricity (%)` = round(elec_access, 1)
  )
write.csv(top10, "ssa-top10-without-electricity.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Send only when the data has a newer year than the last brief that went out.
last_sent_year <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("LAST_SENT_YEAR", "0"))
send_email <- if (latest_year > last_sent_year) "yes" else "no"

access_chart <- energy |>
  filter(iso3 %in% c("SSF", "WLD"), indicator == "elec_access") |>
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("Sub-Saharan Africa", "World"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(year, value, color = name, linetype = name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sub-Saharan Africa" = "#2a78d6", "World" = "#52514e")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Sub-Saharan Africa" = "solid", "World" = "dashed")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2020, by = 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e1e0d9"),
    text = element_text(color = "#52514e")
  )
```

In `r latest_year`, **`r millions(without_now)` million people** in Sub-Saharan Africa lived without electricity, `r change_text`. Access reached **`r round(latest_access, 1)`%** of the population.
